sample.chosen:

Additionally, Cartoon Network's sister channel, Adult Swim, has a dedicated programming block called Toonami that airs anime and action-oriented shows. While Toonami was cancelled on Cartoon Network, it was later revived on Adult Swim and continues to air anime series to this day.

Furthermore, Cartoon Network has also been expanding its programming to include more diverse content, including live-action shows and original animated series. So while there may not be as much anime on Cartoon Network as there was during the Toonami era, there are still opportunities to see anime and other types of animation on the network.
